saw_lines: Campers buy one sturdy stove, keep it for decades, then return only for pans, burners or a second kit.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a camper decides the stove fits them, before any price shows.
Your 12 ads carry 0 proof numbers, so buyers see no reason to trust the stove. Collect one review count or orders shipped figure and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: None of your 12 live ads carries a proof number, so a stove built to last decades has nothing to back the claim. Collect one review count or orders shipped figure, then open two ads with it.
Three of your 12 ads open on the same nu kan du fynda line, so the other openers never get a fair test. Test two new angles against it: decades of use, and a camp meal cooked on it.
None of your 12 live ads carries an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Test a first order offer or a fuel bottle bundle in the opening line of three new ads.
11 of your 12 ads use Shop now, so a buyer who wants one stove lands on a category page. Use See details on ads for one stove like the Stekpanna 25 and keep Shop now for the outlet.

ads_1: Camp scene creative leading with decades of use, tested against a first order offer
